L73: HoloLens Anchor Sharing
L74: # HoloLens WorldAnchor persistence
L75: 
L76: Persistence is a system for saving 【29†World Anchor】 states across multiple runs of the same application. This can be thought of as a “save game” functionality for physical locations in the real world. An example of this is remembering where a game board is placed in the world when the application re-launches.
L77: The `WorldAnchorStore` provides basic functionality for saving and loading World Anchors. Retrieve a `WorldAnchorStore` by calling `WorldAnchorStore.GetAsync` and providing it with a callback. Your callback saves the `WorldAnchorStore` returned so that it can be used for future operations.
L78: 
L79: To save an existing World Anchor, give it a name and call the `Save` function on the `WorldAnchorStore`. See an example below:
L80:     private void SaveAnchor()
L81:     {
L82:         if (!this.savedAnchor) // only save this once
L83:         {
L84:             this.savedAnchor = this.MyWorldAnchorStore.Save("MyAnchor", MyWorldAnchor);
L85:             if (!this.savedAnchor)
L86:             {
L87:                 // Anchor failed to save to the store.
L88:                 // Handle errors here.
L89:             }
L90:         }
L91:     }
L92: 
L93: Loading is essentially a reflection of the above:
L94:     private void LoadAnchor()
L95:     {
L96:         this.savedAnchor = this.Load("MyAnchor", MyWorldAnchor);
L97:         if (!this.savedAnchor)
L98:         {
L99:             // An anchor with that name wasn't saved to the store.
L100:             // Handle errors here.
L101:         }
L102:     }
L103: 
L104: To remove an anchor from the store, call the Delete method on the WorldAnchorStore. To remove all anchors from the store, call the Clear method.
